title: [0.98a] People's Commons 1.5.2
author: MunchkinSlayer
contentHtml:
The People's Commons 1.5.2
The means of life are a common inheritance.



The People's Commons is a minor dirty commie faction on the inhabited Sector's frontier. It is hostile to almost every faction in the Sector, due to the danger its ideology and expansion of the People's Navy brings to them.

Lore and gameplay dump
Spoiler
Its flavour is strongly inspired by the preeminent missile power of our time, China, but in an optimistic reading of its later stage of development; common ownership, extensive automation. Its navy intends to share that achievement with the Sector.

Shared missile guidance systems, advanced seekers and superior missile engineering define a fleet built around precision missiles. The goal with this faction was to build an engaging missile-oriented roster that eschews the missile saturation meta with limited ammo, limited salvo sizes and normal missile hit points. Rewarding and punishing.

Meanwhile, the Commons are struggling with an increasingly entrenched administration. Many senior cadres have grown accustomed to deciding what everyone needs, while reconstruction authorities in puppet revolutionary states keep finding reasons to postpone returning power to the people they liberated.

Support of revolutionary movements within the Sector, while professed enemies are countless, places a constant drain on resources that the population expects to be used to further improve their standard of living.
[close]

Download
The People's Commons 1.5.2

Requires LazyLib 3.0.0 and MagicLib 1.5.6.
Optional: Nexerelin, Combat Chatter.

(gifs have outdated sprites)


Included
  • Twelve new warships, just enough to form distinct doctrines of a fast strike flotilla, a line fleet, and independent commands
  • Three new wings in four-fighter, three-striker and two-bomber sections
  • Seven unique precision missiles, including three interchangeable launchers, with graphical effects
  • Daybreak, a three-world home system just beyond the Core
  • Twenty portraits, four named officials, immersive local descriptions and faction-specific dialogue
  • Three missions to try out each doctrine easily
  • Nexerelin compatible, including blueprint availability in goodies bin
  • Combat Chatter compatible, automatically applied to People's Commons ships/officers with new lines
  • Vanilla tankers and freighters with livery WIP

Identity

Common Fire Solution
Spoiler
The hullmod shares observations to improve native missile guidance. Ordinary ships can develop a full solution alone. Command ships boost responsiveness, memory and simultaneous tracking.
[close]

Common Launch Protocol
Spoiler
The system opens a six-second launch window after 0.9 seconds of preparation. Newly launched native missiles benefit from +25% damage, +50% speed and +50% turning throughout flight. In-flight missiles, aircraft do not receive that upload. NPC AIs have instructions to make best use of CLP.
[close]

Common Maneuver Protocol
Spoiler
The system performs an aggressive lateral thrust, according to player input, alongside providing a reduced-magnitude version of CLP. Offers some tactical maneuverability and allows you to bend your missiles like Beckham. Exclusive to the fast-strike vessels Praxis, Liberation and Initiative.
[close]

Precision arsenal
Spoiler

Spear-KM - Kinetic MIRVs releasing three guided darts
Resolution - Advanced heavy guided missiles. Aggressive lateral RCS thrust maneuver

Campaign
Spoiler
Daybreak contains the planets Equality, Fellowship and Abundance. Located southeast of the core worlds. Starts hostile with most factions for ideological reasons, except benign with the Diktat, Mayasura, Roiders and friendly with the Apex Design Collective. Nexerelin supports faction starts and fixed/random sectors.

Changelog

1.5.0 - Sprite rework and shield balance adjustment

Credits and AI disclaimer
Spoiler
I really wanted to make a unique missile doctrine-roster, largely for my own tastes and wishes, so that's where I spent my energy. AI was used extensively. Generated source images edited, color-graded for Starsector. Vanilla assets by Fractal Softworks.

Code assisted by GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra. Ship silhouettes and layout sketched by me, finished by GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra. Portraits by GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra. Loreful writing 50/50 by me and GPT-6 Astra Ultra.
[close]

Balance impressions are extremely welcome as this is my first roster, balancing is active WIP. Feedback is especially welcome on missile endurance, interception, carrier performance and how the ships feel in various mixed fleets.
